integrity: The all-dimension claim is proved by a field-uniform rank argument and exact induction. Exhaustive finite-field computations are used only as consistency checks.
scientific_limitations: Counts ordinary group-invertible upper-triangular matrices over finite fields. It does not enumerate higher Drazin indices, prescribe the inverse, or extend the formula to arbitrary finite coefficient rings.
title: Exact group-invertible rank enumerator in \(T_n(\mathbb F_q)\)
